WITH members AS (
         SELECT _team_member.team,
            _team_member.player
           FROM _team_member
        ), alltime AS (
         SELECT m.team AS team_id,
            count(m.player) AS member_count,
            COALESCE(avg(a.level), 0::numeric) AS average_level,
            COALESCE(sum(a.coin_balance), 0::numeric) AS total_coins,
            COALESCE(sum(a.games_played), 0::numeric) AS alltime_games_played,
            COALESCE(sum(a.games_won), 0::numeric) AS alltime_games_won,
            COALESCE(sum(a.games_lost), 0::numeric) AS alltime_games_lost,
            COALESCE(sum(a.games_won_in_1), 0::numeric) AS alltime_games_won_in_1,
            COALESCE(sum(a.games_won_in_2), 0::numeric) AS alltime_games_won_in_2,
            COALESCE(sum(a.games_won_in_3), 0::numeric) AS alltime_games_won_in_3,
            COALESCE(sum(a.games_won_in_4), 0::numeric) AS alltime_games_won_in_4,
            COALESCE(sum(a.games_won_in_5), 0::numeric) AS alltime_games_won_in_5,
            COALESCE(sum(a.games_won_in_6), 0::numeric) AS alltime_games_won_in_6
           FROM members m
             LEFT JOIN _mv_wordle_alltime_leaderboard a ON a.player = m.player
          GROUP BY m.team
        ), daily AS (
         SELECT m.team AS team_id,
            COALESCE(sum(d.games_played), 0::numeric) AS daily_games_played,
            COALESCE(sum(d.games_won), 0::numeric) AS daily_games_won,
            COALESCE(sum(d.games_lost), 0::numeric) AS daily_games_lost,
            COALESCE(sum(d.games_won_in_1), 0::numeric) AS daily_games_won_in_1,
            COALESCE(sum(d.games_won_in_2), 0::numeric) AS daily_games_won_in_2,
            COALESCE(sum(d.games_won_in_3), 0::numeric) AS daily_games_won_in_3,
            COALESCE(sum(d.games_won_in_4), 0::numeric) AS daily_games_won_in_4,
            COALESCE(sum(d.games_won_in_5), 0::numeric) AS daily_games_won_in_5,
            COALESCE(sum(d.games_won_in_6), 0::numeric) AS daily_games_won_in_6
           FROM members m
             LEFT JOIN _mv_wordle_daily_leaderboard d ON d.player = m.player AND d.day = EXTRACT(day FROM now())::bigint AND d.month = EXTRACT(month FROM now())::bigint AND d.year = EXTRACT(year FROM now())::bigint
          GROUP BY m.team
        ), weekly AS (
         SELECT m.team AS team_id,
            COALESCE(sum(w.games_played), 0::numeric) AS weekly_games_played,
            COALESCE(sum(w.games_won), 0::numeric) AS weekly_games_won,
            COALESCE(sum(w.games_lost), 0::numeric) AS weekly_games_lost,
            COALESCE(sum(w.games_won_in_1), 0::numeric) AS weekly_games_won_in_1,
            COALESCE(sum(w.games_won_in_2), 0::numeric) AS weekly_games_won_in_2,
            COALESCE(sum(w.games_won_in_3), 0::numeric) AS weekly_games_won_in_3,
            COALESCE(sum(w.games_won_in_4), 0::numeric) AS weekly_games_won_in_4,
            COALESCE(sum(w.games_won_in_5), 0::numeric) AS weekly_games_won_in_5,
            COALESCE(sum(w.games_won_in_6), 0::numeric) AS weekly_games_won_in_6
           FROM members m
             LEFT JOIN _mv_wordle_weekly_leaderboard w ON w.player = m.player AND w.week = EXTRACT(week FROM now())::bigint AND w.year = EXTRACT(year FROM now())::bigint
          GROUP BY m.team
        ), monthly AS (
         SELECT m.team AS team_id,
            COALESCE(sum(mo.games_played), 0::numeric) AS monthly_games_played,
            COALESCE(sum(mo.games_won), 0::numeric) AS monthly_games_won,
            COALESCE(sum(mo.games_lost), 0::numeric) AS monthly_games_lost,
            COALESCE(sum(mo.games_won_in_1), 0::numeric) AS monthly_games_won_in_1,
            COALESCE(sum(mo.games_won_in_2), 0::numeric) AS monthly_games_won_in_2,
            COALESCE(sum(mo.games_won_in_3), 0::numeric) AS monthly_games_won_in_3,
            COALESCE(sum(mo.games_won_in_4), 0::numeric) AS monthly_games_won_in_4,
            COALESCE(sum(mo.games_won_in_5), 0::numeric) AS monthly_games_won_in_5,
            COALESCE(sum(mo.games_won_in_6), 0::numeric) AS monthly_games_won_in_6
           FROM members m
             LEFT JOIN _mv_wordle_monthly_leaderboard mo ON mo.player = m.player AND mo.month = EXTRACT(month FROM now())::bigint AND mo.year = EXTRACT(year FROM now())::bigint
          GROUP BY m.team
        ), yearly AS (
         SELECT m.team AS team_id,
            COALESCE(sum(y.games_played), 0::numeric) AS yearly_games_played,
            COALESCE(sum(y.games_won), 0::numeric) AS yearly_games_won,
            COALESCE(sum(y.games_lost), 0::numeric) AS yearly_games_lost,
            COALESCE(sum(y.games_won_in_1), 0::numeric) AS yearly_games_won_in_1,
            COALESCE(sum(y.games_won_in_2), 0::numeric) AS yearly_games_won_in_2,
            COALESCE(sum(y.games_won_in_3), 0::numeric) AS yearly_games_won_in_3,
            COALESCE(sum(y.games_won_in_4), 0::numeric) AS yearly_games_won_in_4,
            COALESCE(sum(y.games_won_in_5), 0::numeric) AS yearly_games_won_in_5,
            COALESCE(sum(y.games_won_in_6), 0::numeric) AS yearly_games_won_in_6
           FROM members m
             LEFT JOIN _mv_wordle_yearly_leaderboard y ON y.player = m.player AND y.year = EXTRACT(year FROM now())::bigint
          GROUP BY m.team
        )
